description: Records that the paying agent delegated a task to a named agent: a signed credential (did:web:craigmbrown.com#delegation-1, kind 30014) binding the paying wallet, the delegate, the sha256 of the task, scope and deadline. Returns two one-time tokens, one per party, for the later steps: delegate accept, delivery seal, delegator close. Anyone can verify the chain with craigmbrown.com's DID document. It proves who paid and what was handed over, not either party's off-platform identity or the quality of the work. (x402: $0.10 USDC per call)
name: delegation.record
